description: Use this when a user asks what the good deals are in Canada right now, or for Black Friday deals, optionally in a category or under a price. Returns Lowvyn's current verified deals: during a shopping event (Black Friday through Cyber Monday 2026) the event flyer, re-checked every 2 hours against each product's own price history; otherwise the weekly flyer, with prices re-confirmed. Each deal has the current price (CAD), what it is compared against (comparePrice, compareBasis), percent and dollars off, the Lowvyn Score and Deal Verdict, and the same id + canonicalUrl other tools accept. When the flyer has nothing for the category or price asked, it falls back to this week's flyer, then to tracked products priced well below their typical price (fallback says which). flyerUrl is the full flyer on lowvyn.com; watchUrl is where the user can get an email when the price drops; searchUrl (when there is no flyer match) opens Lowvyn search for the category.

category.description: Optional category or product type to filter by, e.g. 'TVs', 'headphones', 'coffee'

name: get_deals
title: Get current deals
